subject: Final-mile bridge: weekend runbook + account reset request
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Morgan Avery <morgan.avery@luminahealth.com>, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final-mile bridge: weekend runbook + account reset request

Morgan / team —

Were entering the final 48 hours before Luminas committed go-live on Tuesday. I put together a short runbook (attached) that covers the finance handoff, procurement acceptance tests, and the commit/reset steps well run if a last-minute model variant needs to be swapped. Key asks from your side:

- Confirm whether PO reference "DL-8392" will be visible to billing (procure@luminahealth.com is the contact we were given).
- Confirm acceptance window: do you need a 2-hour or 4-hour blackout for your staging to verify invoice sampling?
- Please confirm final list of live routes (we currently have 3 production routes pinned).

Internal note for Neha / Ben / Laura: this runbook includes a short finance checklist on page 2 (invoice cutoff, token accounting, demo credits reconciliation). Ben — can you verify the commit-tracker CSV have the final ARR numbers for August (I attached a working version)? Neha — please run the stage-owner ping thats in step 4 of the runbook and collect final owner confirmations. Laura — be ready to approve any last-minute credits; Ive marked the threshold that requires leadership sign-off.

Attachments: runbook-final-mile.pdf (3 pages), commit-tracker-aug28.csv

Thanks — well do a quick sync tomorrow morning at 9:00 PT if anything pops.

Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile bridge: weekend runbook + account reset request

Thanks Avery — quick updates from pipeline hygiene side: 

- I pinged all stage owners this morning (Prod Ready, Billing QA, Legal hold). Responses so far: 6/7 confirmed; one owner (procurement) is still awaiting PO confirmation from Lumina.
- Ben, I noticed two line items in the tracker that still have blank commit owners (rows 17 & 24). Can you confirm whether those are still expected to close this quarter or should be reforecasted?
- For the acceptance window: I recommend we advertise a 2-hour blackout by default and extend to 4 hours only if Lumina explicitly requests it. Keeps our exposure smaller.

Next steps: I will collect final owner confirmations by EOD Monday and update the attached tracker with explicit owner initials. If procurement confirms the PO reference, we can mark the Billing QA stage as green.

Neha Kapoor
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com

From: Morgan Avery <morgan.avery@luminahealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, procure@luminahealth.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final-mile bridge: weekend runbook + account reset request

Hi Avery / team —

Thanks for the clear runbook. A few quick confirmations from Lumina: 

- PO visibility: procurement confirms DL-8392 will be attached to the invoice metadata and visible to your billing team. I copied procure@luminahealth.com to confirm the final PO PDF (they will upload to your vendor portal tonight).
- Acceptance window: well take the 2-hour blackout. If we encounter sampling variance, well escalate to a 4-hour window but will notify you 1 hour prior.
- Production routes: confirmed 3 routes (primary customer-facing route, analytics route, internal admin route).

We also asked our finance ops team to prepare a one-time initial payment (net 30) and confirmed the invoice contact. Expect a DocuSign for SOW amendments by EOD Sun.

Morgan Avery
Director of Partnerships | Lumina Health
morgan.avery@luminahealth.com
+1 (617) 555-0987

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 17:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final-mile bridge: weekend runbook + account reset request

Thanks all — quick rollup after the procurement confirmation: 

- I filled the tracker rows 17 & 24: both moves to "Commit" with owner initials (JH / MK). I also added the final ARR and MRR columns; numbers reconcile with last forecast.
- I attached a snapshot (commit-tracker-aug28.csv) and a short checklist for billing to use at cutoff. Laura, please confirm credit approval threshold; per the runbook any ad-hoc credit > $6k needs leadership approval (flagged).
- Next steps: Neha will run owner confirmations by EOD Monday (shell update the tracker). Avery, please circulate the DocuSign link once Lumina sends it so Finance can tie the SOW amendment to the invoice.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
